Lani & Steve on the Amalfi Coast

Santa Caterina, Amalfi · Il San Pietro, Positano · May 30 to June 4, 2027

Prepared for Lani and Steve

Lani and Steve, here is the whole trip in one place. Two nights at Santa Caterina in Amalfi, a day on the water down the coast, then three nights at Il San Pietro in Positano. Both hotels are booked. The transfers and days out are laid out as options, so tell me which ones you like and I will lock them in.

Tap any day below to jump straight to it. Every address opens in Google Maps and every phone number is tap to call. Anything marked Your pick is waiting on your choice, and prices are per booking in euros, not per person.

The Fine Print

Good to know

How the options work

Every transfer and tour on this page is private, with an English-speaking driver or guide. Prices are in euros for the two of you. Tell me your picks and I will confirm each one here.

Helicopter pricing

The helicopter prices are approximate and are set at confirmation, based on fuel prices and slot availability.

Two bookings, one room at Il San Pietro

Your first night is booked through me and the next two are Steve’s points stay. Both are a Premier Room, and the hotel has linked them so you stay in the same room the whole time.

Check-in and check-out

Il San Pietro check-in is 2:00 PM and check-out is 11:00 AM. If you would like an early check-in or a late check-out anywhere, tell me and I will ask.
